text: Consider the integral /m dz. (a) Enter a value of b such that 22 + 8z + b does not factor. (b) Specify all values of b such that =2 + 8z + b does not factor. (It is exactly for these values of b that it is appropriate to use a trig substitution involving tan(u) to evaluate this indefinite integral.) Note: use interval notation for your answer. (To enter the interval b > 0, use (0, Inf). To enter b < 0, use (—Inf,0]. To enter 1 < b < 2, use (1, 2], etc)
